claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised free concerts every evening at his place, 619 Market Street, St. Louis, with only the best singers engaged.
claims.excerpt: the world, 619 Market Street. Free concert every evening, Best of singers only engaged

claims.statement: Tom Allen was advertised as retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt: ToM ALLEN, retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Advertisement only. Allen does nothing else in the text.
